item.title: Inside Bell Labs, The Best Programmer, Why C Won
item.description:
Brian Kernighan is a former Bell Labs member of technical staff, co-author of the original C book, and the one who popularized “Hello World.” We talked about what Bell Labs was like and the stories behind all the famous tools that were built there.

Beyond C, Kernighan also co-created AWK with Alfred Aho and Peter Weinberger, a programming language widely used for processing text and generating reports. He contributed to Unix text-processing and document-formatting tools, including troff and eqn, and co-authored The Unix Programming Environment with Rob Pike. His work reflects a long-standing focus on making programming more practical, clear, and accessible to others.
